text_block_list.text:
Looking ahead to the climactic Sprinters 
Stakes, summer training camp begins once 
again to hone their skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Supported by the Trainer's love, Curren 
Chan got over the peak of her busy 
schedule and gave a cute smile, showing 
she was all right now.
